keys.definition: Marker that makes an invoice line a vehicle line and states the major.minor version of the convention. It stands in for a BT-24 announcement, which a Factur-X hybrid (closed list) and Peppol (fixed prefix, R004) cannot carry.
keys.valueFormat: ^vehicle/[1-9][0-9]*[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, e.g. vehicle/1.0 (no patch number, never a URL)
keys.conditionality: MUST, exactly once, on every vehicle line, SHOULD be the first row; MUST NOT appear on other lines
keys.anchors: Stands in for BT-24 (Factur-X EN16931 codedb closed list; PEPPOL-EN16931-R004). Precedent for a machine token in BT-160: KoSIT CIUS XRechnung CVD v0.9 attribute 'cva'. Same major.minor practice as XRechnung identifiers.

keys.definition: Why the vehicle appears on this line, seen from the seller (BG-4). supply = the vehicle is the item supplied (a sale, or a purchase documented by self-billing). trade-in = a vehicle taken in from the buyer, shown on an informational line with price 0.00 and no money meaning. service = work, parts, inspection or repair on the vehicle. lease / rental = a periodic charge for using the vehicle. agency = commission or intermediation for a vehicle. transport = transfer, delivery or logistics of the vehicle. other.
keys.codeList: VEH-ROLE 1.0: supply, trade-in, service, lease, rental, agency, transport, other
keys.conditionality: MUST on every vehicle line, SHOULD be the second row
keys.anchors: No EN 16931 equivalent (BT-3 types the document, not the line).

keys.definition: Identification number marked on the vehicle: normally the 17-character VIN of Reg. (EU) 2021/535 Annex II Part 2; for vehicles without one, the national identifier (StVZO § 59 allows other identifiers of up to 14 characters). Same value as BT-128 when both are present. The BG-32 copy is shown by every viewer and lets stacks that cannot yet emit BT-128 conform at Level 1.
keys.valueFormat: ^[A-Z0-9]{1,17}$, upper case, no blanks or hyphens. Expected form ^[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}$ with a valid position-9 check digit (Reg. (EU) 2021/535 Annex II Part 2 Section C: weights 8,7,6,5,4,3,2,10,-,9..2, mod 11, 10 = X). Deviations are warnings only (V-05): the check digit is a refusal ground only for types approved from 2022-07-06 (registration refusals from 2026-07-07)
keys.codeList: BT-128-1 / BT-18-1: UNTDID 1153 'AKG' (Vehicle Identification Number (VIN)); 'VT' (Motor vehicle identification number) accepted on input
keys.conditionality: MUST on every vehicle line whenever an identifier exists (all roles); may be absent only on an order or prepayment invoice before a vehicle is assigned. Level 2: additionally BT-128 with AKG and the same value
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'FIN [vehicle.vin]'. Level 2 also BT-128: CII ram:SpecifiedLineTradeSettlement/ram:AdditionalReferencedDocument {ram:IssuerAssignedID, ram:TypeCode 130, ram:ReferenceTypeCode AKG}; UBL cac:InvoiceLine/cac:DocumentReference {cbc:ID schemeID='AKG', cbc:DocumentTypeCode 130}. Optional header BT-18
keys.anchors: EU registration code E; CoC item 0.10; Reg. (EU) 2021/535 Annex II Part 2 (structure and check digit, verified in the regulation text); ISO 3779 by number; UNTDID 1153 AKG; PL KSeF NowySrodekTransportu VIN; HU newTransportMean serialNum.

keys.definition: Manufacturer brand as in registration field D.1 / CoC item 0.1, without model or trim, spelled as in the source document.
keys.valueFormat: text, 1-60 characters, NFC, trimmed; no control or bidi characters; must not start with = + - @
keys.conditionality: MUST whenever known, all roles
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Marke [vehicle.make]'. Factur-X EXTENDED MAY also mirror it in ram:BrandName (the row stays)
keys.anchors: EU registration code D.1; CoC item 0.1; HU newTransportMean brand (annotated 'Product / type').

keys.definition: Commercial name of the model as in registration field D.3 / CoC item 0.2.1 (e.g. Golf), without make and trim. The full marketing name stays in BT-153.
keys.conditionality: MUST whenever known, all roles
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Modell [vehicle.model]'. EXTENDED MAY also mirror it in ram:ModelName
keys.anchors: EU registration code D.3; CoC item 0.2.1.

keys.definition: Seller's commercial classification at the time of supply. new = never registered and not used except for delivery. pre-registered = registered for the dealer or importer without use by an end customer (Tageszulassung). demonstrator = used as a demonstration or courtesy vehicle. used = all others. Independent of vehicle.newMeansOfTransport (a VAT test) and of the VAT treatment.
keys.conditionality: MUST for roles supply and trade-in; omit for service, lease and rental
keys.anchors: Own definition (no EU legal term).

keys.definition: Date of the vehicle's first registration anywhere (registration field B), also for imported vehicles. Absent means never registered or unknown.
keys.valueFormat: YYYY-MM-DD; YYYY-MM only if the day is genuinely unknown
keys.conditionality: MUST for supply and trade-in of pre-registered, demonstrator and used vehicles; SHOULD on service lines; never with condition = new
keys.anchors: EU registration code B.

keys.definition: Odometer reading in whole kilometres as displayed by an instrument that reads in kilometres, at the reference date: vehicle.odometerDate if present, else BT-72 actual delivery date, else BT-2 issue date. Not converted from miles and not estimated. It states the displayed reading; whether it equals the distance actually travelled is qualified only by vehicle.odometerStatus.
keys.valueFormat: integer ^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,6})$: no group separator, no decimals, no unit text; 0 is valid
keys.conditionality: Exactly one of vehicle.odometerKm / vehicle.odometerMi MUST be present for supply and trade-in of pre-registered, demonstrator and used vehicles and on service lines, unless vehicle.odometerStatus is defective or unknown (then no reading is given). With vehicle.newMeansOfTransport = true an odometer value or vehicle.firstUse MUST be present (V-08). SHOULD for new vehicles
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Kilometerstand (km) [vehicle.odometerKm]', BT-161 '48200'. Labelled name mandatory (statutory feature)
keys.anchors: § 1b Abs. 3 Nr. 1 / § 14a Abs. 4 UStG and Art. 2(2)(b) Directive 2006/112/EC (6,000 km test); KoSIT/FeRD Pflichtangaben row 'Laufleistung'; PL P_22B; HU kms; IT DatiVeicoli/TotalePercorso; no EU registration code; COM(2025) 180 Art. 4a (proposal only).

keys.definition: As vehicle.odometerKm, for an instrument that reads in statute miles. Never converted, so odometer-integrity checks see what the instrument shows.
keys.conditionality: Used instead of vehicle.odometerKm, never together with it (V-13); same conditions
keys.anchors: As vehicle.odometerKm (6,000 km = 3,728 statute miles for the § 1b test).

keys.definition: Maximum net power in kilowatts as entered in registration field P.2 (CoC item 27.1). For hybrid and electric vehicles use the value the registration document shows, not a marketing system power. PS/hp are never sent (display only; 1 PS = 0.73549875 kW).
keys.conditionality: MUST whenever known for motor vehicles on supply and trade-in. With vehicle.newMeansOfTransport = true, this key or vehicle.displacementCm3 MUST be present (V-08; more than 7.2 kW test, § 1b Abs. 2 Nr. 1 UStG)
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Leistung (kW) [vehicle.powerKw]', BT-161 '110'. Labelled name mandatory
keys.anchors: EU registration code P.2 ('if available' in Directive 1999/37/EC per the legislation.gov.uk copy; EUR-Lex check pending; the Council compromise on COM(2025) 179 drops the qualifier); CoC item 27.1; § 1b Abs. 2 Nr. 1 UStG; KoSIT/FeRD row 'Leistung'; HU enginePower.

keys.definition: Issuer's statement that at the date of supply the vehicle is a 'new means of transport' for VAT: a motorised land vehicle of more than 48 cm3 or more than 7.2 kW that has covered no more than 6,000 km OR was first put into service no more than 6 months earlier (Art. 2(2)(b) Directive 2006/112/EC; § 1b Abs. 2 Nr. 1, Abs. 3 Nr. 1 UStG). A statement of fact; the VAT treatment stays in the VAT terms. Land vehicles only: vessels and aircraft (§ 1b Abs. 2 Nr. 2/3) are out of scope of 1.0. Not the same as condition = new.
keys.conditionality: MUST be true on every line that supplies a new means of transport intra-EU under Art. 138(1) or (2)(a) (§§ 6a, 14a Abs. 4 UStG, also § 2a sellers); V-08 then applies. MAY as a factual statement on other supplies. 'false' only as an active statement. Art. 138(2)(a) supplies to buyers without a VAT id are outside 1.0 because category K fails BR-IC-02 (fatal)
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Neues Fahrzeug (§ 1b UStG) [vehicle.newMeansOfTransport]', BT-161 'true'. Labelled name mandatory
keys.anchors: Art. 2(2)(b), 138, 226(12) Directive 2006/112/EC; §§ 1b, 14a Abs. 4 UStG; FzgLiefgMeldV § 2; PL Adnotacje/NoweSrodkiTransportu; HU newTransportMean; IT DatiVeicoli.

keys.definition: Date the vehicle was first put into service; the 6-month test runs from here. Often the first registration date, but earlier if the vehicle was used before registration. This is the KoSIT/FeRD row 'Zeitpunkt der ersten Inbetriebnahme'. An absent row carries no meaning; in particular it is not a statement that the vehicle was never put into service.
keys.conditionality: With vehicle.newMeansOfTransport = true: SHOULD whenever the vehicle was put into service before the invoice date, and either this key or an odometer value MUST be present (V-08). Otherwise MAY. Whether first registration always counts as first entry into service (UStAE 1b.1) is not verified; until it is, issuers state the date they rely on
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Erste Inbetriebnahme [vehicle.firstUse]'. Labelled name mandatory
keys.anchors: § 1b Abs. 3 Nr. 1, § 14a Abs. 4 UStG; Art. 2(2)(b) Directive 2006/112/EC; FzgLiefgMeldV § 2 ('if before the invoice date'); HU firstEntryIntoService; PL P_22A; IT DatiVeicoli/Data.

keys.definition: The vehicle on this line is supplied under the margin scheme for second-hand goods (Art. 311-325 Directive 2006/112/EC; § 25a UStG). A hint for receivers (no input VAT deduction, resaleable under the margin scheme) that the 2017 VAT model cannot express. It never replaces the VAT category, BT-120 or the BG-1 mention.
keys.conditionality: MUST in 1.x on every margin-scheme vehicle line under the 2017 model (category E for domestic and intra-EU margin supplies, G for exports, Art. 321 Directive / § 25a Abs. 5 S. 2 UStG); MAY with category F (2026 model); MUST NOT appear on a line with category K (Art. 313(2) Directive; § 25a Abs. 7 Nr. 1 b and Nr. 3 UStG; V-07 error). Provisional until a written tax-adviser sign-off of the encoding; that sign-off is a condition of the v1.0 freeze
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Differenzbesteuerung [vehicle.marginScheme]', BT-161 'true'. Always with the BG-1 note 'Gebrauchtgegenstände/Sonderregelung' (§ 14a Abs. 6 UStG; Art. 226(14) mention 'Margin scheme — Second-hand goods' in other language versions), BT-151/BT-118 = E, G or F, and the BT-120 text
keys.anchors: Art. 226(14), 313, 321, 325 Directive 2006/112/EC (consolidated 14.04.2025); §§ 14a Abs. 6, 25a UStG; EN 16931-1:2026 category F; PL P_PMarzy_3_1; HU marginSchemeIndicator SECOND_HAND; IT Natura N5 + RF14; ES Veri*Factu ClaveRegimen 03.

keys.definition: Registration number as in registration field A, without the country sign. It identifies the registration, not the vehicle, and is personal data when it can be linked to a natural person.
keys.valueFormat: upper case ^[A-ZÄÖÜ0-9][A-ZÄÖÜ0-9 -]{0,14}$ as printed (e.g. XX-VE 1); receivers compare after removing blanks and hyphens
keys.conditionality: SHOULD on roles service, lease and rental when the vehicle is registered; on other roles only when the receiver needs it (data minimisation); omit on invoices to natural persons unless required
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Kennzeichen [vehicle.plate]'. Only when no VIN is known, BT-128 MAY carry the plate with scheme ABZ (as the CEN example huf_example_cii.xml does); the row then repeats it (V-18)
keys.anchors: EU registration code A; UNTDID 1153 ABZ; PL plate (optional).

keys.definition: State in which the vehicle is currently registered, i.e. the state that issued vehicle.plate.
keys.conditionality: SHOULD whenever vehicle.plate is present
keys.anchors: Distinguishing sign of the registering state (Directive 1999/37/EC).

keys.definition: Qualifies the odometer reading. displayed = the reading as shown by the instrument, total distance not verified by the issuer (default meaning when the row is absent). replaced = instrument or display replaced, the reading does not show the total distance. rolled-over = the counter has wrapped. defective = no reading possible. unknown = no reading available to the issuer. A 'verified' status is deliberately not offered in 1.0 (warranty exposure, pending legal review).
keys.codeList: VEH-ODOMETER-STATUS 1.0: displayed, replaced, rolled-over, defective, unknown
keys.conditionality: SHOULD whenever the reading is not a plain displayed reading; MUST be defective or unknown when an odometer key is required but no reading is given; MUST NOT be defective or unknown together with an odometer value (V-17)
keys.anchors: Own definition; legal review pending (an odometer statement in the leading structured part can become an agreed quality, § 434 BGB).

keys.definition: Date the odometer reading was taken, when it differs from the reference date (BT-72 actual delivery date, else BT-2). Typical cases: workshop intake, trade-in appraisal.
keys.conditionality: SHOULD whenever the reading date differs from the reference date; SHOULD on service lines
keys.anchors: COM(2025) 180 Art. 4a (proposal only).

keys.definition: Marketing derivative or trim (engine, gearbox, equipment line), e.g. '2.0 TDI Life'. Not the type-approval type/variant/version of field D.2.
keys.conditionality: SHOULD whenever known
keys.anchors: Own definition.

keys.definition: Cylinder capacity in cubic centimetres (registration field P.1, CoC item 25). Omitted for battery-electric vehicles.
keys.conditionality: SHOULD for combustion engines. With vehicle.newMeansOfTransport = true, this key or vehicle.powerKw MUST be present (more than 48 cm3 test)
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Hubraum (cm³) [vehicle.displacementCm3]', BT-161 '1968'. Labelled name mandatory
keys.anchors: EU registration code P.1; CoC item 25; § 1b Abs. 2 Nr. 1 UStG; HU engineCapacity.

keys.definition: Energy source(s) of the propulsion, primary first. Hybrids list the combustion fuel and electric (petrol,electric); the hybrid type goes into vehicle.powertrain.
keys.codeList: VEH-FUEL 1.0: petrol, diesel, electric, lpg, cng, lng, hydrogen, ethanol, biodiesel, biomethane, other (own tokens; IVI 2.0 EnergySource and KBA Kraftstoffcode only as informative mappings, licence of the IVI list unverified)
keys.conditionality: SHOULD for motor vehicles on supply and trade-in
keys.anchors: EU registration code P.3 (no code list); CoC items 26/26.1.

keys.definition: Drive architecture. combustion; hybrid = not externally chargeable (NOVC-HEV, including mild hybrids); plug-in-hybrid = externally chargeable (OVC-HEV); battery-electric; fuel-cell; other.
keys.codeList: VEH-POWERTRAIN 1.0: combustion, hybrid, plug-in-hybrid, battery-electric, fuel-cell, other
keys.conditionality: SHOULD for hybrid, electric and fuel-cell vehicles
keys.anchors: CoC items 23 (pure electric) and 23.1 (OVC-HEV, NOVC-HEV, OVC-FCHV, NOVC-FCHV).

keys.definition: Vehicle category as in registration field J / CoC item 0.4: Reg. (EU) 2018/858 (M1-M3, N1-N3, O1-O4, optional suffix G) or Reg. (EU) 168/2013 (L1e-L7e).
keys.conditionality: SHOULD; especially on invoices to public buyers (same values as KoSIT CVD)
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'EU-Fahrzeugklasse [vehicle.category]', BT-161 'M1'. In a CIUS XRechnung CVD invoice the CVD BT-158 'CVD' and the 'cva' row stay; vehicle.category then repeats the CVD class
keys.anchors: EU registration code J; CoC item 0.4; KoSIT CIUS XRechnung CVD v0.9 (M1, M2, M3, N1, N2, N3).

keys.definition: Basic body colour: the ten CoC basic colours plus beige, gold, silver and other. The manufacturer's colour name is not part of 1.0.
keys.codeList: VEH-COLOUR 1.0: white, yellow, orange, red, violet, blue, green, grey, brown, black (CoC item 40, Reg. (EU) 2020/683 Annex VIII) + beige, gold, silver, other
keys.conditionality: SHOULD on supply and trade-in
keys.anchors: EU registration code R; CoC item 40.

keys.definition: German KBA manufacturer key number from registration certificate Part I (national field 2.1; numbering from secondary sources).
keys.conditionality: SHOULD for vehicles with a German registration document
keys.anchors: ZB I field 2.1 [secondary source].

keys.definition: German KBA type key: the first three characters of national field 2.2 of registration certificate Part I, without the check or variant characters that follow [format from secondary sources].
keys.conditionality: SHOULD together with vehicle.hsn
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'TSN [vehicle.tsn]'. Never BT-158 with UNTDID 7143 'TSN' (Taxonomic Serial Number)
keys.anchors: ZB I field 2.2 [secondary source].

keys.definition: Month in which the next periodic roadworthiness test (HU) is due (registration field X).
keys.conditionality: SHOULD on supply of used vehicles and on service documents that include an HU
keys.anchors: EU registration code X (optional today; mandatory in the COM(2025) 179 proposal).

keys.definition: Usable (net) energy content of the traction battery when new, as stated by the manufacturer. Not the state of health.
keys.conditionality: SHOULD for battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles
keys.anchors: No registration or CoC code; Reg. (EU) 2023/1542 Annex VII (state of certified energy, a related quantity).

keys.definition: EU whole-vehicle type-approval number, or national approval number, as in registration field K.
keys.conditionality: MAY; useful on new-vehicle invoices from manufacturers and importers
keys.anchors: EU registration code K ('if available'); CoC type-approval number.

keys.definition: Exhaust emission level from the type approval.
keys.codeList: VEH-EMISSION 1.0 (provisional): euro-1, euro-2, euro-3, euro-4, euro-5, euro-6, euro-6b, euro-6c, euro-6d-temp, euro-6d, euro-6e, euro-7, euro-iv, euro-v, euro-vi, other (to be checked against CoC item 47 values before freezing)
keys.conditionality: MAY; useful for used vehicles
keys.anchors: EU registration code V.9 (not on the 2014 EUR-Lex list read; unverified); CoC item 47.

keys.definition: Combined CO2 emissions in g/km from the type approval (WLTP where available).
keys.codeList: unit fixed: g/km (no Rec 20 code, so never BT-212)
keys.conditionality: MAY; useful for M1/N1 fleets
keys.anchors: EU registration code V.7 (unverified on EUR-Lex); CoC item 49.

keys.definition: EU bodywork code (CoC item 38): AA saloon, AB hatchback, AC station wagon, AD coupé, AE convertible, AF multi-purpose vehicle, AG truck station wagon; plus the N, bus, trailer and special-purpose codes.
keys.codeList: Reg. (EU) 2018/858 Annex I Part C (AA-AG checked; BA-BX, CA-CX, DA-DG, SA-SH to be checked before freezing)
keys.conditionality: MAY; useful for vans, trucks and trailers
keys.anchors: CoC item 38; code J.1 in the COM(2025) 179 proposal.

keys.definition: Number of seating positions including the driver (registration field S.1, CoC item 42).
keys.conditionality: MAY
keys.anchors: EU registration code S.1; CoC item 42.

keys.definition: Model year designated by the manufacturer; may differ from the production year.
keys.conditionality: MAY
keys.carrier: BG-32: BT-160 'Modelljahr [vehicle.modelYear]'. UNTDID 7143 'RY' exists for BT-158 but is not used
keys.anchors: Own definition.

keys.definition: Date of manufacture as stated in the CoC (item 0.11).
keys.conditionality: MAY; useful for new vehicles
keys.anchors: CoC item 0.11.

keys.definition: All-electric range in km from the type approval (WLTP combined).
keys.conditionality: MAY for battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles
keys.anchors: CoC item 49 (WLTP values).

keys.definition: State of health of the traction battery as a percentage of rated capacity, read from the battery management system or a test on the date given in vehicle.batterySohDate.
keys.conditionality: MAY for used battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles; requires vehicle.batterySohDate (V-16)
keys.anchors: Reg. (EU) 2023/1542 Art. 14 (SoH data in the BMS, read access for the purchaser).

keys.definition: Date on which the state of health given in vehicle.batterySohPct was determined.
keys.conditionality: MUST when vehicle.batterySohPct is present
keys.anchors: No standard term.

keys.definition: HTTPS link to the battery passport of the traction battery, i.e. the content of the passport QR code (Reg. (EU) 2023/1542 Art. 77, applicable from 2027-02-18 for EV batteries). A link only; no passport content is copied into the invoice.
keys.conditionality: MAY for battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles whose battery has a passport
keys.anchors: Reg. (EU) 2023/1542 Art. 77 (passport, QR code, ISO/IEC 15459 identifier).

keys.definition: Technically permissible maximum laden mass in kg (registration field F.1).
keys.conditionality: MAY; useful for N and O categories and fleets
keys.anchors: EU registration code F.1; CoC technically permissible maximum laden mass.

keys.definition: Reference into a proprietary vehicle catalogue: identifiers only, never catalogue content. Repeatable, one row per scheme.
keys.codeList: VEH-CATALOG-SCHEME (registry, with a licence note per scheme): dat, schwacke, jato, ktype
keys.conditionality: MAY; only after the catalogue owner has cleared printing identifiers on invoices
keys.anchors: DAT €uropa-Code, Schwacke code, JATO ID, TecDoc KType (all proprietary).

keys.definition: Number of registered keepers (Halter) the vehicle has had up to the supply, as documented in registration certificate Part II or the national register. The buyer of this supply is not counted, nor is a dealer that was never the registered keeper. An issuer declaration.
keys.conditionality: MAY on used supply; omit if unknown; provisional until a legal review (a stated value can become an agreed quality, Beschaffenheitsvereinbarung)
keys.anchors: Own definition.

keys.definition: Issuer's declaration that it knows of accident damage beyond minor damage ('true') or knows of none ('false'). A declaration, not an expert finding; an absent row means no statement.
keys.conditionality: MAY on used supply; provisional until a legal review (a stated value can become an agreed quality, Beschaffenheitsvereinbarung)
keys.anchors: Own definition.

keys.definition: Issuer's declaration that known damage is not repaired ('true') or that it knows of no unrepaired damage ('false'). An absent row means no statement.
keys.conditionality: MAY on used supply; provisional until a legal review (a stated value can become an agreed quality, Beschaffenheitsvereinbarung)
keys.anchors: Own definition.
